notes.title: v1.1.0.9.5 Update
notes.content:
Endless Mode Stage Configuration Adjustments
1.New Boss will appear at least once as a hidden third boss within the first 30 waves.
2.New Boss will appear at least once as a regular boss between waves 30–50.
3.Existing Bosses now have enhanced versions (marked with ★), appearing in Endless Mode with increased HP, attack power, and movement speed.

Balance Adjustments
1.If coin drops in a single wave exceed 2000, the drop rate will gradually decrease.
2.When movement speed exceeds 100%, the effective value will gradually be reduced.
3.The minimum value for effect size settings is now 0.7.
4.Some Meditations and Equipment have increased possession limits.
5.Power of Flame and Power of Voodoo have been strengthened.

notes.title: v1.1.0.8 Update
notes.content:
1.Endless Mode balance adjustments.
2.Defense damage reduction rebalanced.
3.Monster bullet and magic damage rebalanced.
4.Improved monster death splitting behavior.
5.Bosses now have 1.5 seconds of invincibility upon appearance.
6.Added tip messages.
7.Fixed a bug where Stage 9 was not unlocked after updating.
8.Weapon balance adjusted: Icewind Hammer and Whirlwind Axe.

notes.title: Summer Sale & New Update Live!
notes.content:
[p]Hello everyone![/p][p]
[b]Rhythm Witch: Beat Death[/b] has joined the Steam Summer Sale — now [b]10% OFF[/b]!
At the same time, a brand-new chapter [b]"Tower of Eternity"[/b] is now live![/p][p]Take on the all-new stage [b]Tower of Eternity[/b], and once you reach the 20th floor, you'll unlock [b]Endless Mode[/b] — a thrilling, non-stop rhythm combat experience![/p][p]Battle against [b]7 powerful new bosses[/b], including:
🌕 Crimson Wolf Fenrir
🛡️ Animated Armor
👁️ Greater Fiend Eye
🐉 Golden Dragon
👹 Demonplate
🔥 And the ultimate foe — the [b]Inferno Jester Mage[/b]![/p][p]Prove you're the true master of rhythm![/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45002866/91d66b163a54f42fd8f7d14fb7c0de757c5a9385.png"][/img][/p][p]
Below are the full update and balance details:

New Features[/p][p]1.Unlocked Level 9: Tower of Eternity.[/p][p]2.Unlocked Endless Mode. Enter Endless Mode after reaching Wav 20 or higher in Level 9. In Endless Mode, enemy HP increases significantly every 10 floors.[/p][p]3.Added 16 new Achievements.[/p][p]4.Added 8 new pieces of Equipment.[/p][p]5.New Weapons added: Ricochet Thunder Orb, Greatsword.[/p][p]6.New Meditations added: Arcane Flash, Sacred Wings.[/p][p]7.7 new Bosses added.[/p][p]8.New Streamer Safe Mode added.[/p][p][/p][p]Dynamic Difficulty Mechanic[/p][p]1.If the player’s level is too low, enemy HP will be reduced accordingly.[/p][p]2.After Wave 10, if the player’s level is too high, enemy HP will be increased accordingly.[/p][p][/p][p]Optimization[/p][p]1.Optimized performance for enemy death splitting.[/p][p]2.Adjusted vertical movement speed to compensate for slower motion caused by perspective distortion.[/p][p]3.Added statistics for bonus damage per second (including bullet splitting and attribute damage).

Bug Fixes[/p][p]1.Fixed a bug where refresh counts reset to 0 when reloading the game.[/p][p]2.Fixed an issue where attack range affected the rotation radius of Guardian Skills.[/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments — System[/p][p]1.In Auto Mode, the attack multiplier penalty when taking damage is adjusted from -3 to -1.5.[/p][p]2.Luck now caps the maximum drop rate of coins and items at 80%.[/p][p]3.Reduced the actual bonus effect of ATK Radius.[/p][p]4.In Frenzy mode, efficiency of dispersed Rhythm Chests and Magic Circles increased by 20%.[/p][p]5.When a Boss is present, the drop rate of coins and items is increased.[/p][p]6.HP Regen effect increased by approximately 50%.[/p][p]7.Beastmaster: Damage reduction from the Defense attribute increased by 30%.

Balance Adjustments — Weapons & Abilities[/p][p]1.Buffed: Holy Laser, Thunderstorm, Arcana Strike, Earth Spikes, Wind Blade, Scatter Bow, Insectomancy, and all melee weapons.[/p][p]2.Guardian Inferno: Rotation radius increased by 33%.[/p][p]3.Shuriken and Whirlwind Axe: Number of hits reduced.[/p][p]4.Meditate - Power of Flame strengthened.[/p][p]5.Meditate - Power of Thunder and Power of Voodoo weakened.[/p][p]6.Meditate - Strength, Magic, and HP Regen strengthened.[/p][p]7.Meditate - Sacred Wings and Arcane Flash: Functions and balance adjusted. [/p][p][/p][p]Balance Adjustments — Runes & Abilities[/p][p]1.Rune \[Frenzy Regen]: Effect increased.[/p][p]2.Rune \[Campfire]: Effect increased, boosting Heart drop rate.
[/p]

notes.title: v1.0.10.2 Update – Mac version now available
notes.content:
New Features:
Added Mac version support.

notes.title: v1.0.10.1 Update
notes.content:
New Features:
1. Added a “Max Effect Size” setting when “Effect changes with ATK Radius” is enabled.
(Default value is x1.5. Setting it to x1 can significantly reduce overly flashy effects caused by increased attack range.)

Optimizations:
1.Improved monster spawn positions and counts in horizontal-style stages.
2.Fixed: When purchasing a weapon that is placed in the first slot of the backup bag, the selected weapon could not be merged or sold.
3.Fixed: The ATK Radius bonus shown on weapons was lower than the actual effect.
(Corrected a calculation error and adjusted the ATK Radius bonus so the actual effect closely matches the previous balance.)
4.Fixed display issues on 1440x900 resolution screens.
5.Equipment Merchant and Blacksmith will now always appear in Wave 9.

notes.title: v1.0.9.1 Update
notes.content:
New Features:
1.Introduced 3 new equipment items.
2. Starting from Wave 8, the Equipment Shop has a chance to offer Epic-grade equipment.

Optimizations:
1.Added a re-check system for Steam achievements in case they fail to unlock due to unexpected issues.
2.Safeguard: The Beat key and other controls can no longer be assigned to the same button.
3.A 1.5-second delay is added before each wave starts to better synchronize with the music.
4.Controller support expanded to include PS4 and Switch Pro controllers.
5.The Equipment Shop now displays a “Missing Seals for the Weapon” hint.

Balance Adjustments:
4.In Shooting Mode, combo multiplier is no longer reduced for early beats during Fever.
2.Reload time in Shooting Mode is now faster and scales with the song's BPM.
3.Reload sound effect in Shooting Mode has been adjusted.
4.Tracking projectiles from some bosses now move slower.
5.Faith-type weapons and Crimson Lightning have been strengthened.

notes.title: v1.0.8.1 Update
notes.content:
Optimizations:
1.When unlocking equipment and weapons through achievements, the corresponding entries in the Gallery will now be unlocked immediately.
2.Hell Mode has been adjusted to have 3 difficulty levels. The original version now corresponds to Level 3.

notes.title: v1.0.7.3 Update
notes.content:
Bug Fixes:
1.Fixed a bug where the boss HP UI would not disappear after a battle ended when two bosses appeared.
2.Fixed an issue where musical notes from treasure chests and magic circles would fly out of the scene.

Balance Adjustments:
1.Significantly reduced the number of obstacles in the environment (trees, small rocks, tombstones) — they no longer block player movement.
2.Reduced the number of traps in the environment and decreased trap damage (Trial difficulty remains unchanged).
3.Lowered the HP of monsters in the first 3 waves.
4.Reduced the difficulty of Stages 7 and 8.

notes.title: v1.0.6Update
notes.content:
1.Added a toggle option for hit effect display.
2.Fixed missing sound effects when hitting on beat.
3.When customizing controls, buttons without icons will now display text labels instead.
4.Optimized display issues for 3340x1140 resolution.
5.Optimized display issues for 2560x1440 resolution.
6.Modified unlock conditions for Advanced and Frenzy Rhythm modes:
Winning a run will unlock both modes.
Failing a run will also unlock both modes, provided Auto Mode has already been unlocked.

notes.title: v1.0.5 Update
notes.content:
1.Fixed issues in the Japanese translation.
2.Added detailed information for HP regeneration, including the actual recovery rate per second.
3.Corrected controller button mappings for certain gamepads.
4.Adjusted the order of some music tracks.
